summary: Verified from official pages: Kinmen pays NT$20,000 for scrapping an old scooter and buying an electric one, and NT$10,000 for a new electric scooter. That is the highest county-funded amount of the eight. Residents only. The scooter purchase and scrapping must be done by 30 Nov 2026, applications close 15 Dec, and the budget (about 160 swaps) may run out first. Whether Kinmen's money stacks with the central 環境部 incentive is unclear. Chiayi City pays 12,000 for a swap and 8,000 for new, Chiayi County 14,000 and 8,000, Pingtung 6,000 and 3,000 (one source says 4,000), all through 31 Dec 2026. With central money, Chiayi City advertises up to 24,300 (37,300 low-income) and Chiayi County works out to about 26,300. Central 經濟部 money (7,000) must be applied for by 10 Dec. Hualien has only an expired 2025 programme (1,000). We could not check Taitung, Penghu or Lienchiang. No amount reaches parity with a NT$50k gas scooter. Nothing is known for 2027.
